Select the first 1000 IC50 activity rows with non-null pChEMBL values for target CHEMBL1743126. Join target_dictionary to assays to activities to molecule_dictionary to compound_structures. Filter activities where standard_type is IC50, standard_relation equals '=', and pchembl_value is not null. Return assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, and pchembl_value. Keep every qualifying activity row without deduplication. Sort by molecule_chembl_id then assay_chembl_id. Limit to 1000 rows.
